findings.original_claim: Clarifications only minor/clerical/adverse performance and only when awarding without discussions; communications is separate mandatory stage.
findings.guide_location: Interactions with Contractors and Quick Review
findings.required_change: Use: The coursebook uses legacy clarification/communication/discussion labels. Current RFO 15.202 permits clarifications from proposal receipt through award to resolve ambiguities and seek nonmaterial supporting information, but not revise a proposal, cure a deficiency/material omission, or change material technical or cost elements. If competitive negotiations permit revisions, the KO establishes a competitive range and negotiates with each responsible offeror in it under 15.204. Cite FAR-Overhaul-Part15-2026.
findings.explanation: Keeps coursebook recognition while teaching current controlling distinctions.

findings.original_claim: Do not reveal Government findings/specific numbers or negotiate task performance.
findings.required_change: Use: Technical team members must not disclose Government analysis or commit to changed work without KO concurrence and delegated authority; the KO controls negotiation strategy and authorized exchanges. Protect another offeror's proprietary solution, price and source-selection information. Cite FAR-Overhaul-Part15-2026, section15.404(b).
findings.source_basis: RFO15.404(b) expressly requires KO concurrence for disclosure of recommendations/conclusions
findings.explanation: Absolute wording conflicts with meaningful KO-led bargaining and could prevent required discussions.

findings.original_claim: Fact-finding section does not explicitly identify PMO support role.
findings.required_change: Add: The PMO supplies technical/program personnel to evaluation teams and supports the KO; the KO remains the focal point for offeror communications and leads negotiations. Cite edo-3-2-3-source-selection-2025, p25.

findings.original_claim: Deficiency defined using legacy combination-of-weaknesses language and many legacy Part15 citations imply current numbering.
findings.guide_location: Interactions with Contractors / Deficiencies; opening note
findings.required_change: Use current definition: A deficiency is a proposal part that fails to conform to a material RFP requirement. Add one chapter note: Legacy FAR15.3/15.306 coursebook references map to current RFO15.201-15.205; consult the active DoD deviation for implementing overlays. Cite FAR-Overhaul-Part15-2026.
findings.explanation: Prevents obsolete paragraph citations and definition from being memorized as current. Preserve original coursebook source for historical labels.

notes: All 35 slides visually reviewed including image-only interaction flow p21: discussions anticipated -> communications -> competitive range -> bargaining/discussions; no-discussions -> clarifications -> selection. Guide covers sequence but RFO update supersedes rigid stage model.
Existing guide correctly narrows coursebook demand to discuss all weaknesses to significant weaknesses and corrects coursebook automatic-protest-stay overstatement. Preserve these improvements.

Exact current DoD RFO Part15 signed attachment remains earlier-audit access limitation; official model text fully retrieved, legacy DFARS15M corroborated, avoid inventing changed DoD-specific procedure.
implementation_status: Recommendations only; guide edits owned by integrating agent.
